D.comparison: student test score or behavioral scale outcomes

cells.quote: The key finding is that sample sizes of 40 to 60 schools that are typically included in clustered RCTs for student test score or behavioral scale outcomes will often be insufficient for binary outcomes.
cells.note: The study text reports a theoretical power analysis rather than an intervention effect; no effect size is printed.

result.effect: 98.8% of the full data size accuracy

cells.quote: For Llemma34b, the performance at 400 training data already achieves 98.8% of the full data size accuracy. Based on these results, we conclude that training a model with 400 proofs is suﬃcient for adequate results.
cells.note: The supplied study text truncates before the training-size sweep results; this quote is copied from the wiki entry as permitted when the relevant study text is not provided.
